title: Lesson
description: A knowledge base entry: one universal mobile-tool UX lesson learned from a losing candidate. This is the stored form of a knowledge base entry, persisted in shared/knowledge_base.json. The curator (gemini-3.5-flash, thinking high) emits the curator_output subset; the core write helper adds id, created_at, applied_count, and prevented_repeats when it appends to knowledge_base.json. Lessons are universal patterns, never specific to one request. No em dashes in any string value.

id.description: Stable id, for example lesson_001. Assigned by the core write helper.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Assigned by the core write helper.

lesson_class.description: Which judge axis this lesson improves.

ux_anti_pattern.description: The named failure pattern this lesson guards against.

tags.description: Retrieval tags from the shared vocabulary. Used by the tag-based BM25 retriever.

lesson_text.description: One to two sentence rule the next implementer should follow.

good_pattern.description: The concrete pattern to use instead.

score_delta.description: Score impact observed for the loser, a penalty at or below 0.

applied_count.description: How many later builds had this lesson injected. Starts at 0.

prevented_repeats.description: How many later builds avoided this anti-pattern after injection. Starts at 0. Drives the repeat-failures metric.

anti_pattern.description: UX anti-patterns plus design anti-patterns from the shared vocabulary.

curator_output.description: What the curator emits per loser, or null when nothing generalizable is found. The core write helper enriches this into a full Lesson by adding id, created_at, applied_count 0, and prevented_repeats 0. Documented in shared/schemas/README.md.

examples.lesson_text: Primary action must sit in the bottom third for thumb reach. Top-right buttons fail on tall layouts.
examples.bad_pattern: top-right action button on a tall single-screen layout
